title: Blood-Brain Barrier — CNS ↔ PNS membrane
philosophy: Not JUST a barrier. A selective membrane. Nutrients IN, toxins OUT. The BBB splits the RSS spine from the PNS — the CNS processes, the PNS senses.

CNS.role: Central Nervous System — brain + spine + processing

eastGate.function: processing, ollama, Forgejo, data server, Tor

CNS.spine: RSS feed — 3194 items flowing OUT to old web
CNS.brain_blood: ollama inference, mushroom processing, cron heartbeat
CNS.protection: Water Lock (OSINT in, nothing seeps to provider)

PNS.role: Peripheral Nervous System — sensors + displays + limbs

steamGate.function: display, sensors, local AI, bubble tube

PNS.peripheral_blood: sensor telemetry, WiFi RSSI, temperature, battery, display data
PNS.motor_output: display rendering, sound, LED, physical output (Epson printer)

BBB.role: Blood-Brain Barrier — selective membrane between CNS and PNS
BBB.location: The USB-C nerve (steamGate ↔ eastGate) and the LAN fabric

ALLOW: northGate telemetry (GPU, WiFi, coords via ADB)
WiFi triangulation data (RSSI from both LANs)
FILTER: raw display frames (stay on PNS, render locally)
gaming traffic (stays on PNS, never touches brain)
raw OSINT intake (processed first, then nutrients flow)
mushroom internals (stay in CNS, only output flows)
BLOCK: beardog family keys (immune system, CNS only)

optic_chiasm.crossing: LEFT HAND (northGate) → RIGHT EYE, RIGHT HAND (eastGate) → LEFT EYE
optic_chiasm.chiasm_point: steamGate (3rd eye bubble) — where CNS meets PNS

RSS_spine.role: The spinal cord — output from CNS to the world
RSS_spine.PNS_access: READ ONLY — PNS can display RSS but never write to it

PNS_nerve_bundle.role: Peripheral nerves — sensor input from PNS to CNS
PNS_nerve_bundle.CNS_access: PROCESS — CNS digests sensor data through mushrooms

split_ratio.CNS_processing: 100% of inference, 100% of mushrooms, 100% of RSS output
split_ratio.PNS_sensing: 100% of sensors, 100% of display, 100% of motor output
split_ratio.BBB_crossing: telemetry IN, HUD pages OUT, culture (sourdough) BOTH

data_flow.OSINT_in: blackholes → water lock → CNS processing → nutrients
